query:
-- Plants : état des identifiants externes
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_wikidata,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gbif_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_gbif,
  SUM(CASE WHEN europeana_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_europeana,
  SUM(CASE WHEN itis_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_itis,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pow_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_pow
FROM plants;
